subject: FYI trailer 53912 last load - for your compliance file
body:
Hi Meridian,

Heads up for your files since your system probably still shows our trailer 53912 on your Northstar steel load into DC135.

After we unloaded for you Wed, we ran a local for one of our direct customers -- caustic tank cleaner in totes (UN1719, corrosive) from Garland to Mesquite yesterday. Trailer has NOT been washed yet.

So 53912 is empty in Dallas TX now, available Monday 11/16. Fine with dry freight, just not food until we get it washed.

Thanks,
Kelly Osei
Prairie Haul Lines | MC-518772
